profile.headline: Process-oriented software developer seeking development/leadership roles in AI and full stack development.
profile.summary: I'm an innovative software engineer with a background in Full Stack web development, artificial intelligence, and networking. I'm comfortable working individually, and I love joining new teams. My current goal is to further expand my skill set across a wider set of tools and tech stacks. When programming, I prioritize clarity, scalability, and efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Architect and Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Directed a development team in designing, developing, and managing the software infrastructure, architecture, and business logic of a B2B SaaS AI tool to boost software team velocity. Oversaw all aspects of the engineering life cycle, including strategic planning, design, coding, documentation and deployment. Managed hiring and team dynamics, fostering a culture of innovation and operational excellence. Lead both architectural decisions and development with a focus on optimizing operations and enhancing productivity.

LLM-Driven Retrieval Augmented Generation for AI Software Developer
Independently designed and developed a GPT chat app with a proprietary retrieval algorithm to find, analyze and edit code files within a codebase. The application took your git url, and you could chat with an AI to answer questions and request changes in the code. Instead of conventional semantic search, I designed a proprietary retrieval algorithm for this use case. 

Context-Aware/Transparent AI Software Designer
Independently designed and developed an AI SaaS tool for software design which converts high level requirements into technical specifications and pseudocode instructions for development (used in conjunction with above AI Software Developer).  The customer software context is 100% transparent, verifiable and editable.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Node.js · Front-End Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed continuous integration and deployments for a SaaS User Verification Platform.
Led architecture and technology planning, including database configurations and process improvements across multiple environments.
Designed training modules for new developers, integrating them seamlessly into development processes.
Identify and alleviate bottlenecks in the cross-team development lifecycle. 
Architect and plan tech debt refactors in the codebase, documentation hubs, postman projects, infrastructure configuration, database schemas, etc. 
Design and administer training modules to onboard new developers and acquaint them with our products and processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Spring MVC · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Implemented microservices architecture using Java and SpringBoot for backend solutions
Developed and maintained customer-facing billing and payment solutions as part of a larger team focused on service quality for 5G customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In an agile team of ~15, developed a cloud-based distributed Packet Capture Management System in Java and Javascript using React, Hibernate, JPA, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and other tools. Balanced front-end and back-end work on a distributed MVC architecture moving further towards microservices.  
 - Developed software features and defect fixes, collaborated with team leads to redesign implementation
 - Participated in semi-weekly stand-ups and biweekly agile sprint planning meetings
 - Provisioned several virtual machines to build and deploy our software onto
 - Contributed to maintaining and enriching our Confluence project with development techniques
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Spring MVC · Front-End Development

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description:
Write proposals for new programming class curriculums
Individually design and develop class resources: curricula, source code, lectures, syllabi
Teach programming classes to students of ages 9 through 18

positions.title: Acedemic Tutoring, Private Music Lessons
positions.description: I offer in-depth k-12 and peer academic tutoring and private music lessons (Theory, Piano, Percussion) in the Prince William / Fairfax area. I do everything I can to meet the needs of my students.

positions.title: Stem Instructor
positions.description:
Configure laptops for more than 20 elementary school students in a classroom environment
Collaborate with other instructors to conduct a class session lasting 90 minutes 
Classroom management, interfacing with parents and school faculty.

positions.title: Percussion Coach
positions.description:
Instructor at Warm Springs Middle, Dorothy McElhinney Middle, and Vista Murrieta High School. 
Coached middle and high school students in groups of 15 students or less, 
Instructed students in proper musical performance techniques 
Managed live digital audio equipment, coordinated 6-month show productions
Conducted Auditions, set technical performance goals, tutored individuals
